description: Afore AF5K-SL sample telemetry frame — synthetic test fixture for Phase 0 validation

blocks.comment: Block 1: Inverter status, output power, grid power (0x0200-0x0212, 19 regs)
Block 2: PV1/PV2 voltage, current, power (0x0228-0x0230, 9 regs)
Block 3: Battery state, SOC, voltage, current, power (0x07D0-0x07D8, 9 regs)

decoded.comment: Expected decoded values after applying profile scaling and sign conventions

battery.comment: Battery power: raw=-200 (Afore convention: negative=charge), canonical=+200 (scale=-1 flip)

grid.comment: Grid power: -200W = exporting to grid (canonical convention: negative=export)

sign_conventions.battery_power: Afore reports NEGATIVE during charge. Profile scale=-1 flips to canonical POSITIVE=charging.
sign_conventions.battery_current: Sign convention UNVERIFIED in Phase 0. Assumed negative=discharge for this fixture.
sign_conventions.grid_power: Canonical: positive=import, negative=export. This fixture shows export (-200W).

modbus_frames.comment: Raw Modbus RTU frames (with CRC) for bus replay and decoder testing

request_block1.description: Read holding regs: slave=1, FC=03, start=512 (0x0200), count=19 (0x0013)

response_block1.description: Response: slave=1, FC=03, byte_count=38 (0x26), 19 registers × 2 bytes, CRC placeholder
response_block1.note: CRC marked XX XX — compute via Modbus CRC-16 (poly 0xA001) before bus replay

request_block2.description: Read holding regs: slave=1, FC=03, start=552 (0x0228), count=9 (0x0009)

response_block2.description: Response: slave=1, FC=03, byte_count=18 (0x12), 9 registers × 2 bytes, CRC placeholder

request_block3.description: Read holding regs: slave=1, FC=03, start=2000 (0x07D0), count=9 (0x0009)

response_block3.description: Response: slave=1, FC=03, byte_count=18 (0x12), 9 registers × 2 bytes, CRC placeholder

normal_operation.description: Daytime operation: PV producing 1000W, battery charging 200W, exporting 200W to grid

night_zero_pv.description: Night: PV=0, battery discharging, importing from grid

battery_full_standby.description: Battery at 100% SOC, standby state, no charge/discharge

sign_convention_validation.description: Critical Phase 0 test: verify battery power sign flip (scale=-1) works correctly

oracle_cross_validation.comment: For CP4 cross-validation against Solarman Home Assistant sensors

phase0_validation_gates.gate1_register_addresses: Confirm all VERIFIED register addresses decode to plausible values
phase0_validation_gates.gate2_sign_conventions: Battery power and grid power signs match observed charge/discharge and import/export states
phase0_validation_gates.gate3_power_balance: PV = Battery + Inverter Output + Grid (within 2% tolerance)
phase0_validation_gates.gate4_unverified_promotion: All UNVERIFIED registers cross-checked against inverter display
phase0_validation_gates.gate5_endurance: ≥99.5% valid read rate over 24-72h, zero writes, no Solarman degradation
